title: Frontend onboarding flow + React Query hook for initial wallet funding

requirements.summary: Trigger onboarding after Internet Identity sign-in and surface insufficient admin funds errors without changing displayed balances.
acceptanceCriteria: After signing in as a never-before-seen Principal, the UI triggers onboarding and the BalanceIndicator updates to show +10 PKR without a full page refresh.
After signing in as an existing user, the onboarding call does not change the user’s balance.
If onboarding fails due to insufficient admin funds, the UI shows an English error (toast or inline) and does not change any displayed balances.

file_operations.description: Add an authenticated-session effect that calls the onboarding React Query mutation once per login (keyed by current Principal), and shows an English toast on failure. Use the existing global Toaster/sonner notification capability to display errors; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend backend error normalization to recognize and map the onboarding insufficient-funds message (e.g., "Admin balance not enough!") to a clear English UI string, without affecting other error handling.

requirements.summary: Add a React Query mutation hook for onboarding that invalidates/refetches balance queries on success so the BalanceIndicator updates immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: A new React Query hook exists for onboarding/initial funding and is used by the sign-in flow.
On success, the hook invalidates/refetches at minimum the caller balance query (and admin wallet query when applicable) so UI updates immediately.

file_operations.description: Create a new React Query mutation hook (e.g., useOnboarding) that calls the backend onboarding capability via the actor, and on success invalidates/refetches the existing ['balance'] query and also ['adminWalletBalance'] to keep admin displays in sync.
Wire the new onboarding hook into the post-login flow so the mutation is invoked after sign-in and successful results drive immediate balance refresh via query invalidation/refetch.
